title: PixelLife
description: a custom pixelmon modpack featuring contraptions and food stuff
body:
A Custom Pixelmon Modpack including Various Delight food stuffs and Create Contraptions as well as some Client QOL Features

this pack is currently undergoing periodic review

featuring; an expansive Create suite, Railcraft Reloaded, Expansive Delights for farming and eating alongside training your Pixel Pals

Pack Built to play with custom server mods collection included in server list - server packs available on request

BE AWARE: Pixelmon packs its own serverlist into the list by Default


Bringing Pixelmon to a world featuring an Expansive Create and Farmers Delight suite along with various Server Quality mods


Server Road map includes Plans for an annual League style tournament, Rank Structure, Player owned Towns And Gyms, Vote rewards and a secondary NPC driven Solo Adventure
